stayType: Large holiday park with self-catering, glamping and touring pitches
accommodation: Self-catering holiday homes, glamping, and tent, tourer and motorhome pitches (North Devon Gazette: 817 pitches across statics, lodges, touring and tents, plus a glamping village)
suitableFor: Families, groups, campers and tourers, dog owners (dog option in booking)
dogs: Booking form allows 1–2 dogs; park-specific policy not stated
beachAccess: Set directly on Croyde Bay beach (official site)
confirmedFeatures: Indoor tropical pool with flume, bars and restaurant, takeaways, Costa, Nisa supermarket, launderette, Wi-Fi in accommodation, EV charging, kids' club, soft play, tennis court, entertainment, park and beach surf shops with hire
overview: Ruda is a large holiday park run by John Fowler Holidays, set right on Croyde Bay in North Devon. It offers self-catering homes, glamping and touring pitches, with a tropical indoor pool, bars, a supermarket and full family entertainment. John Fowler bought it from Parkdean Resorts in 2025.
surfTripFit: Direct access to Croyde Bay and on-site surf shops with hire make it one of the most convenient surf bases in the area, though it is a busy, entertainment-led park.
